value: The red trail ended with Nefarian's defeat and the recovery of the fragment before it could be destroyed. When it was brought back to Anachronos, the bronze dragon spoke of Vaelastrasz's soul finding rest. The shard was not merely a treasure won from a raid. Its return fulfilled the charge of a guardian whose own strength had failed him. One piece of the scepter was recovered, but the cost of its keeping remained part of the story that the restored artifact would carry.
